top_signals.title: Copper Extends Drop as AI Stocks Weigh Ahead of Fed Meeting
top_signals.summary: Copper extended last week’s drop as artificial intelligence stocks came under further pressure, sapping risk appetite ahead of the Federal Reserve’s policy meeting.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: EM Stocks Fall Before Key Earnings, Brazil in Focus as Lula Wins
top_signals.summary: Emerging-market stocks started the week lower as investors awaited earnings from some of the world’s biggest technology companies for clues on whether the artificial intelligence trade can recover from a bruising selloff.

top_signals.title: Morgan Stanley Sees Further China Stock Downside Before Bottom
top_signals.summary: Chinese stocks are poised for further losses before valuations bottom, according to Morgan Stanley, as weak macroeconomic and consumption momentum continues to weigh on sentiment.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Audi defends plans for a $4 billion Georgia plant amid VW restructuring, tariffs
top_signals.summary: Audi's CEO defended the company's plans for a $4 billion plant in Georgia, calling it a business decision to grow sales and reduce exposure to U.S. tariffs.
